description: APIs that exist on Bun but throw or silently do nothing when called, and matrix differences that are values rather than behavior. The compatibility matrix only records whether an API exists. Curated by reading Bun's Node compatibility docs and sources at the release the matrix was generated with.

child_process.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:child_process

punycode.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:punycode

readline.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:readline

readline/promises.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:readline/promises

tty.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:tty

vm.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:vm

worker_threads.note: documented as implemented; the compatibility matrix does not cover node:worker_threads

repl.note: node:repl is a stub: repl.start does not exist and the other members throws a NotImplementedError

trace_events.note: is a stub: createTracing returns an object without enable or disable, and getEnabledCategories always returns an empty string

async_hooks.createHook.note: hooks can be created and enabled but are never called

v8.serialize.note: uses JavaScriptCore's serialization format, so data is not interchangeable with Node's

v8.deserialize.note: uses JavaScriptCore's serialization format, so data is not interchangeable with Node's

test.run.note: needs an explicit files array, and the watch, coverage, shard, only, concurrency, name pattern and forceExit options throw a NotImplementedError

timers.active.note: throws a NotImplementedError unless passed a timer from setTimeout or setInterval; legacy timer objects are not supported

timers.enroll.note: throws a NotImplementedError unless passed a timer from setTimeout or setInterval; legacy timer objects are not supported

timers.unenroll.note: throws a NotImplementedError unless passed a timer from setTimeout or setInterval; legacy timer objects are not supported

module.register.note: does nothing; use Bun.plugin for loader hooks

process.config.note: holds Node's build configuration; its keys are values, not APIs

process.versions.note: lists the versions of Node's bundled dependencies, which Bun does not ship

process.release.note: release.lts is undefined on non-LTS Node releases too

process.report.excludeEnv.note: a setting whose value type differs, not an API

process.stdin.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Bun's are plain streams, so only socket-specific members differ

process.stdout.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Bun's are plain streams, so only socket-specific members differ

process.stderr.note: the matrix recorded Node's stdio as sockets; Bun's are plain streams, so only socket-specific members differ

async_hooks.asyncWrapProviders.note: internal provider type constants, which differ with each runtime's resources

*globals*.AbortSignal.any.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Bun

*globals*.ReadableStream.from.note: the Web API data lists it as missing, but it exists on Bun
